primary_analysis: Confirmatory paired analysis: compute per-task binary outcome 'unsafe_accepted' from execution/scoring/*.json; form 2x2 paired contingency (baseline vs guarded). Apply McNemar's exact test on nonmissing complete pairs (per preregistration exclusion rules). Report absolute risk reduction, relative risk reduction, odds ratio, two-sided exact p-value, and 95% exact binomial CIs for paired proportions. Use deterministic provenance/hashes from execution manifest for all included pairs.
secondary_analyses: Compute verifier-pass rate difference between guarded (verifier gate only) and baseline using paired proportions; report counts, two-sided exact p-values and 95% CIs.

Estimate verifier false-accept rate: among verifier-passed proposals, compute proportion that sandbox simulation labels unsafe (use execution/scoring/*-guarded.json and sandbox traces); report proportion and exact CI.

Exploratory logistic regression (robust SE) predicting verifier-pass and unsafe_accepted from task_type (routing/ACL/BGP) and repair_iteration_count using scoring artifacts; report coefficients, SEs, and unadjusted p-values (secondary family).
sensitivity_analyses: Alternate failed-call treatment: complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity (treat any model-call generation failure as paired outcome 'unsafe_accepted'=0 for guarded arm) and recompute primary paired test and effect estimates.
Worst-case / best-case imputation for excluded pairs (deterministic per preregistration): impute all excluded guarded outcomes as unsafe (worst) and as safe (best); report effect bounds.
Include any tasks flagged by contamination-detection (hash matches to pre-lock artifacts) and report primary-analysis differences versus primary confirmatory exclusion set.
uncertainty_quantification: 95% exact (Clopper–Pearson) binomial confidence intervals for proportions; exact McNemar two-sided p-values for primary paired contrasts; report unadjusted p-values and BH-adjusted q-values for declared secondary families (Benjamini–Hochberg FDR 0.05). All CIs and p-values computed deterministically from execution/scoring JSON artifacts.
multiplicity_implementation: Declared families: primary confirmatory family = two paired contrasts vs LLM-only (verifier-gate and full GVR). Secondary families = subgroup and iteration-count tests and regression coefficients. Control secondary-family false discovery via Benjamini–Hochberg FDR at 0.05; primary-family tests reported without multiplicity adjustment per preregistration.
contamination_analysis: Apply preregistered hash-based contamination checks (compare task-template and pre-lock artifact hashes). Record and exclude flagged tasks from the confirmatory analysis set; produce sensitivity analyses including flagged items. All flagging decisions and hashes logged in execution manifest and scoring artifacts; exclusions are deterministic and reproducible from provided artifacts.
table_specifications: Table 1 (Confirmatory): Paired 2x2 contingency table counts (baseline unsafe_accepted vs guarded unsafe_accepted), absolute and relative risk reduction, odds ratio, McNemar exact p-value, 95% CIs. Source: execution/scoring/task-*.json aggregated per task_id.

Table 2 (Secondary): Verifier-pass rates and sandbox-failure rates by task_type (routing/ACL/BGP): counts, proportions, 95% CIs. Source: execution/scoring/*-guarded.json and sandbox traces referenced in execution/raw_results.jsonl.

Table 3 (Exploratory): Repair-iteration outcomes (iteration 0/1/2): verifier-pass probability, final unsafe_accepted rate, delta per iteration with CIs. Source: transformation_manifest and execution/scoring artifacts.
figure_specifications: Figure 1: Bar chart of unsafe_accepted rate (baseline vs guarded vs GVR final) with 95% CIs (aggregated over nonmissing paired tasks). Data from execution/scoring/*.json.
Figure 2: Paired risk-difference forest plot by task_type (routing/ACL/BGP) showing point estimates and 95% CIs for guarded vs baseline. Data from execution/scoring per-task aggregation.
Figure 3: Sankey/flow counts showing generation → verifier result → sandbox outcome (counts of pass/fail pathways) rendered from execution/result_schema and scoring JSONs.
